card.name: Punctuation before section and day numbers
card.fires_on: The period or space just before a number in regulation citations (45 CFR 46.402, 21 CFR 50.3) and in section cross-references. Also the space after "at least" before "14 days" in MAOI washout wording.

modes.label: Regulation citation numbers
modes.description: A period or space right before the section number in a CFR or section citation.

modes.label: Washout interval wording
modes.description: The word "least" or the space after it, just before "14 days" after an MAOI.
modes.example: Conversely, at least<< >>14 days should be allowed after stopping

modes.label: Section cross-references
modes.description: The period inside a numbered section reference in a label heading list.

card.writes: No clear link to the output; it mostly suppresses approval and permission words.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before a number in a legal citation or a "14 days" interval.
